text:
jess_support: FYI ACME opened a ticket — they saw ~2x token usage after their client process crashed and immediately retried. They say the app shows a single send but the ledger has two entries.
ben_billing: Can you paste the ledger rows / invoice line ids? want to scope refund impact.
jess_support: Ledger rows: L-2029-ACME-11 and L-2029-ACME-12. Customer reports request at 2026-10-03T12:03:12Z, client TCP reset at 12:03:18, app restarted and re-sent at 12:03:19. SDK v0.12.4. They included SDK logs:
```
[12:03:11.984] sending payload id=cli-7a4f
[12:03:18.103] socket error ECONNRESET
[12:03:18.107] process restart
[12:03:19.210] resend payload id=cli-7a4f
[12:03:19.345] got 200 ok (server request_id: rq-55e2)
```
jess_support: Their app used the recommended ephemeral header X-Client-Req-Id (SDK) but they don't persist it across restarts.
carlos_infra: I pulled ingress logs for rq-55e2: saw two distinct arrivals with different idempotency header values (one missing header). First hit had id header `null`, second had `cli-7a4f`. Seems the first attempt reached gateway but without the id header, so metering counted it separately.
ingress-bot: duplicate-detection: window=30s, observed_duplicate=false for payload hash 0x9b1a
marta_sre: If the first attempt arrived without id and returned SYN/ACK loss, it could still be metered because metering hooks run on request acceptance before full ack. Need to check metering-service traces for those ledger ids.
ben_billing: Quick math: customer was billed for 1.98x tokens based on those two rows. I'll provisionally block the invoice line while we triage. How many tokens to credit?
jess_support: From the request body sizes and our token estimator looks like ~12,600 tokens extra. Customer asked for immediate credit while we investigate.
carlos_infra: Repro plan: 1) Run a local proxy that drops ACKs after sending upstream, 2) use SDK v0.12.4 without persisting X-Client-Req-Id so second send gets same client id but first lacked header, 3) observe ledger. I'll run in a sandbox and attach logs.
marta_sre: Also querying metering-service: `SELECT * FROM meter_events WHERE ledger_id IN ('L-2029-ACME-11','L-2029-ACME-12')` showed two meter events with different dedupe keys (one null). That confirms dedupe didn't trigger.
ben_billing: I'll issue a provisional credit for 12,600 tokens and mark invoice pending. Need a short client-facing note.
jess_support: Draft note: "We confirmed duplicate metering caused by a client-side restart that dropped the ephemeral id header. We've credited 12,600 tokens and are recommending an SDK patch + server-side mitigations." Thoughts? :thumbsup:
carlos_infra: Mitigations: A) short-term: expand dedupe window to 60s for tenant ACME + accept empty dedupe key fallback using request body hash (risk: false positives). B) medium: patch gateway to persist `x-client-req-id` from connection-level metadata when present or derive stable id from TLS session where allowed. C) long-term: SDK change to persist id to disk across quick restarts.
marta_sre: For rollout: do A for this tenant today, B as a 1-week infra change, C we can coordinate with SDK owners next sprint.
ben_billing: I'll send the refund and note on invoice. Please confirm once mitigation A is applied so I can close the credit.
jess_support: I'll update the customer and attach the provisional credit. ETA for A?
carlos_infra: Spun up a canary and patch is on staging now. Once I flip config for tenant ACME it should be effective immediately. Will post the switch log.
ingress-bot: tenant-config-change: tenant=ACME dedupe_window=60s applied by carlos_infra at 2098456198
carlos_infra: Switched. Metering rechecked for new requests, dedupe logic now returns true for replayed requests within 60s.
jess_support: Customer confirmed receipt of credit and accepted mitigation plan. They'll upgrade SDK or persist id.
ben_billing: Credit applied. Closing invoice line. Please add a short postmortem with action items (SDK bug, gateway improvements, billing check).
marta_sre: Adding to sprint tracker: INFR-447 (gateway id persistence), SDK-593 (persist id across restarts).
jess_support: Closing loop with ACME and marking support ticket resolved. Thanks all. :party:
